title: VICTORY: Trump's Iran Deadline Forces Regime's NEW Leader to Blink and Accept Ceasefire | Next News Network
text:
President Trump's hardline approach to Iran just delivered another major foreign policy victory, as the regime's newly-installed Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei reportedly scrambled to accept a ceasefire deal in the final hours before Trump's military deadline expired.
According to sources familiar with the negotiations, Mojtaba Khamenei - who recently took power after his father's death but remains largely hidden from public view - personally intervened to green-light the ceasefire as the threat of massive U.S. bombardment became undeniably real.
This dramatic last-minute capitulation shows exactly why America voted to put Trump back in the White House. While the Biden regime spent four years appeasing Iran and watching the mullahs grow bolder, Trump is already forcing these terrorist-sponsoring thugs back into their corner through strength and decisive action.
Iran's New Leader Shows He's Just as Weak as His Father
The fact that Mojtaba Khamenei - a man so afraid of his own people he won't even show his face publicly - had to personally step in to avoid Trump's wrath speaks volumes about the respect America commands under real leadership.
Remember, this is the same Iranian regime that spent the Biden years launching proxy attacks, threatening our allies, and openly mocking American weakness. Now they're scrambling to cut deals before Trump's military deadlines hit.
"Iran knows Trump means business," said one foreign policy expert. "They remember what happened when Trump took out Soleimani. They're not going to test those waters again."
This ceasefire represents exactly the kind of peace-through-strength diplomacy that Trump promised on the campaign trail. No endless wars, no appeasement - just clear deadlines backed by overwhelming American power.
How refreshing to have a president who makes America's enemies sweat instead of America's allies. The mullahs are learning the hard way that the Trump Doctrine is back, and their days of walking all over America are officially over.
